Nina to send Quarry Bank the required 24-hour advance notice for authentication changes affecting its tenants no later than Saturday 01:00 UTC to satisfy the contractual requirement before the Sunday deployment.
Omar to update the rollout ticket with Priya as the named rollback lead for the Sunday 01:00-03:00 UTC window and add the 30-minute go/no-go checkpoint before deployment.
Amara to provide formal application engineering sign-off once the compatibility note is filed and the plan reflects the 5% first cohort with 48-hour compatibility flag.
Nina to provide formal customer operations sign-off once Quarry Bank notice is confirmed sent.
Omar to provide formal site reliability sign-off once the rollback lead and go/no-go checkpoint are added to the ticket.
